_readme: This file allows you to customize column and table descriptions for better SQL generation
_instructions: 1. Copy this file and rename it to column_metadata.json
2. Set COLUMN_METADATA_FILE environment variable to point to your file
3. Customize descriptions for your specific database tables/columns
4. Restart the application to load changes
5. Note: Database metadata takes precedence over this file

table_name.description: Description of what this table stores

columns.column_name: Description of what this column represents

vendors.description: Vendor and supplier information for procurement

columns.name: Vendor company name
columns.country: Country where vendor is located (used for location-based queries)
columns.city: City where vendor headquarters is located
columns.created_at: Date when vendor was added to system

columns.customer_id: Reference to customer who placed the order
